stock.description: Operating as an investment holding entity, Beijing Sports and Entertainment Industry Group Limited maintains a principal focus on the sports and entertainment domain, with operations spanning mainland China and various other Asian nations. Its business portfolio encompasses the development, ongoing operation, and meticulous management of air domes, alongside the processing of materials crucial for their fabrication. Furthermore, the company delivers specialized consulting and management expertise within the sports industry. Formerly known as ASR Logistics Holdings Limited, the enterprise adopted its present designation, Beijing Sports and Entertainment Industry Group Limited, in June 2016. Established in 1991, the firm's corporate headquarters are situated in Beijing, People's Republic of China.
